title: SB2738 (2022 Regular): RELATING TO ELECTRIC GUNS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2022/bills/SB2738_.HTM; sha256 0a02dd65f7a7fd35e1da7a7c12f10b1f44a3e415eb48054c6c3f39b38110cb39)
provenance.note: Version read: as-filed (introduced). Counted as gun policy because it restricts where an electric gun (a weapon the firearms chapter regulates) may be carried; it does not regulate firearms or ammunition. SECTION 3 (HRS 134-87) adds the new section to the exemption cross-reference for law enforcement and the National Guard. Bill has no passage vote on file.
